added.name: Claude Fable 5.2
added.excerpt: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 is a frontier model for the most demanding technical work, with gains over Fable 5.1 in coding, reasoning and vision.

added.name: Muse Ember
added.excerpt: Meta's Muse Ember is the smallest and most efficient model in the Muse family, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and processing large collections of images, files, audio and video.

added.name: Drex Max Finance
added.excerpt: Drex Max Finance is Nace AI's multimodal decision model for finance, with the same System One request shape as Drex Max.

added.name: Drex Max v1.1
added.excerpt: Drex Max v1.1 is Nace AI's largest multimodal decision model, the successor to Drex Max and Drex v2.0 for image-capable decision tasks.

added.name: Granite Embedding
added.excerpt: IBM's Granite Embedding is an open text embedding family (30M and 278M cuts) for retrieval, clustering, and semantic search.

added.name: Nomic Embed Text
added.excerpt: Nomic Embed Text is an open text embedding model from Nomic AI, trained for high-quality semantic search and retrieval.

added.name: Snowflake Arctic Embed
added.excerpt: Snowflake Arctic Embed is Snowflake's open text embedding family, spanning small to large cuts across 100+ languages.

added.name: MX-BAI Embed Large
added.excerpt: MX-BAI Embed Large is Mixedbread AI's open text embedding model, returning a 1,024-dimension dense vector over a 512-token window.

added.name: BGE-Large
added.excerpt: BAAI's BGE-Large is an open multilingual text embedding model returning a 1,024-dimension dense vector over a 512-token window, across 100+ languages.

added.name: All MiniLM
added.excerpt: All MiniLM is the sentence-transformers MiniLM family (L6-v2 and L12-v1 cuts) for fast, compact text embedding.
